import json,re
d=json.load(open('products/services/welfare-tender/notice-104449-2026-ocds.json'))
s=json.dumps(d)
out=[]
for k in ['contractPeriod','maxExtent','renewal','duration','year','period','months','value']:
  for m in re.finditer(k,s,re.I):
    out.append(k+': '+s[max(0,m.start()-150):m.end()+200])
open('products/services/welfare-tender/term-extract.txt','w').write('\n---\n'.join(out))
print(len(out))
r=d['releases'][0]
t=r['tender']
print(json.dumps({k:t.get(k) for k in ['value','contractPeriod']})[:600])
for l in t.get('lots',[]):print(json.dumps({k:l.get(k) for k in ['value','contractPeriod','renewal','hasRenewal']})[:900])
